name: Huế Amazing Marathon 2026
short_description: The Huế Amazing Marathon 2026 is a full marathon event in Huế, Vietnam on 30 August 2026, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km options also available.
ai_summary: The Huế Amazing Marathon 2026 is a road running event taking place in Huế, Vietnam, over race weekend 29-30 August 2026, with the main marathon day on 30 August. Organized by BOLT EVENT as part of the 'Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series,' it offers four distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km.

core_facts.venue: Le Duan street, beside the Flag Tower (Ky Dai) and Phu Van Lau

pros: Flat course past the Imperial City, Thien Mu Pagoda and four Perfume River bridges
Generous six-and-a-half-hour marathon limit, about 9:15 per km
Small, shallow field: a sub-3:20 marathon was enough for the top ten in 2026
Can be paired with the Aqua Warriors Hue aquathlon on the same weekend
cons: Hot even at night: 31°C at the 2.30am start in 2026 and 33°C by the 9am limit
No route map, aid-station plan or elevation profile was published on the registration page
Fees are not refunded; changing distance or name costs 200,000 VND

excerpt_quotes.quote: Chạy giải này vừa chill vừa sướng, cảnh đẹp quá, bình minh trên biển đẹp quá
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner comment reported at the sister event Quảng Trị Amazing Marathon 2026 (same organizer/series, Tiền Phong news coverage)

research_highlights: Huế Amazing Marathon 2026 is scheduled for 29-30 August 2026, with race day on 30 August, offering four distances: 5km, 10km, 21km and 42km.

The event is part of Bolt Event's 'Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series', the same organizer that also runs Aqua Warriors Vietnam Series (Hạ Long, Vân Đồn, Quảng Trị, Huế) since 2024 and the Quảng Trị Amazing Marathon.

Start and finish were on Le Duan street beside the Flag Tower; the 21km and 42km crossed the Da Vien, Truong Tien, Nguyen Hoang and Phu Xuan bridges on otherwise flat roads.

faqs.question: When is the Huế Amazing Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Huế Amazing Marathon 2026 takes place during race weekend 29-30 August 2026 in Huế, Vietnam, with the primary marathon distance event scheduled for 30 August 2026. Runners planning to attend should mark this weekend on their calendars accordingly, as the event spans two days in the city of Huế.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The Huế Amazing Marathon 2026 offers four distance options for participants: a full marathon at 42.195km, a half marathon at 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to select a distance that suits them.

faqs.question: How much does registration cost?
faqs.answer: Individual entry rose over four phases from 24 April to 15 August 2026. The 42km cost VND 799,000 to 1,569,000, the 21km VND 699,000 to 1,379,000, the 10km VND 499,000 to 989,000 and the 5km VND 399,000 to 789,000, per the official price table on the Pace8 registration page.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Huế Amazing Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event is organized by BOLT EVENT, which runs it as part of their broader 'Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series.' This series appears to host similar marathon events across different Vietnamese cities, with the Huế edition being one instance scheduled for the 2026 race calendar.
